name: The Expositor's Greek Testament
author: Various (ed. W. Robertson Nicoll)
description: Collective philological and exegetical commentary on the Greek New Testament. Partial coverage: Volume 1 only (the four Gospels) -- see the books list.
sourceEdition: 1897, George H. Doran Company, New York -- University of Toronto Library scan (Volume 1 of 5)
attribution: General editor: Rev. W. Robertson Nicoll, M.A., LL.D. Volume 1 contributors: Rev. Alexander Balmain Bruce, D.D. (Matthew, Mark, Luke -- "The Synoptic Gospels"); Rev. Marcus Dods, D.D. (John).
notes: PARTIAL COVERAGE by explicit editorial decision (2026-08-27): only Volume 1 (Matthew, Mark, Luke, John) is published, from a planned 5-volume, ~20-contributor work covering the whole NT. Volumes 2-5 (Acts through Revelation) are held back pending further work -- see review/commentaries/expositors-greek-testament/PENDING.md. Per Juan's explicit instruction, Greek is preserved EXACTLY as this 1897 scan's OCR rendered it, without any 'corrected' reference text alongside it (unlike this Wave's Bengel and Lightfoot imports) -- EGT is a work of textual criticism that discusses variant Greek readings by design, so showing a 'standard' text next to its own argument risks misrepresenting that argument as an error. The volume's own continuous printed Greek NT text (separate from the verse-by-verse analytical notes) is excluded, matching the same convention already used for Lightfoot's Colossians/Philemon -- Verbo already provides Greek NT text elsewhere. This is a collective work: each Gospel's author field names its actual contributing scholar (Bruce or Dods), with Nicoll credited only as general editor in this manifest's own author/attribution fields, never attributed as if he wrote the exegesis himself.
